description: Example workflow for solving a facility location optimization problem

workflow.notes: Record chat_id and filename for subsequent steps

workflow.command: python scripts/create_chat.py --message='Facility location optimization for agricultural warehouses...' --agent_type=optverse --filenames=需求分析输入.md

expected_response.content: Based on the requirement analysis, I have formulated the optimization model...

workflow.notes: Record chat_id for all subsequent steps

expected_download_response.content:
# Requirement Analysis

## Problem: Facility Location Optimization
...

workflow.notes: Present artifacts to user, ask for confirmation

expected_response.content: I have generated the mathematical model code and documentation...

workflow.notes: Download modeling stage artifacts and present to user

workflow.action: Upload data file and run data check
workflow.command: hcloud OptVerse UploadFile --X-Chat-Route-Id=<route-id> --agent_type=optverse --chat_id=8adba10e-... --file=模型数据--农业.xlsx --cli-region=cn-east-3

expected_response.content: Data validation complete. All checks passed...
Final artifacts generated. Model is ready for publishing...

workflow.sub_command: hcloud OptVerse PublishChat --chat_id=8adba10e-... --name=agri-warehouse-optimization --type=optverse --description='Facility location optimization for agricultural warehouses' --cli-region=cn-east-3
workflow.notes: Published asset ID returned - workflow complete!
